name: Adoni Zedek
overview: Adoni Zedek was the king of Jerusalem during the time when Joshua led Israel in their conquest of Canaan. Upon hearing of Israel's victories over Jericho and Ai, and the peace treaty made by Gibeon with Israel, Adoni Zedek feared greatly because Gibeon was a significant royal city. In response, he formed an alliance with four other Amorite kings to wage war against Gibeon, seeking to counter Israel's growing influence. This coalition highlights the political and military challenges Israel faced as they established themselves in the Promised Land.
